notes: The 1967 volume of the Recreation and Park Commission. Curated: design approvals, a pool name, the Cowell Hall site, a dedication.

coverage.remaining: Routine items not curated. Not placed: John F. Kennedy Drive dedication (no page), Lloyd Flood's proposed Music Concourse restaurant (Jan 26, idea only), the zoo aviary remodel (Mar 23), the Victorian Park garage letters.

findings.address_as_written: Restaurant at the Marina Small Craft Harbor
findings.description: The Recreation and Park Commission approved Jens Hansen's revised plan, already passed by the Art Commission, for the restaurant to be built at the Marina Small Craft Harbor by Charley Brown Restaurants, Inc.
